title: Prepare the local bootstrap base for first self-use
description: Satisfy the two operator-owned prerequisites for the first live Yoyodyne run: authenticate the installed Claude Code CLI with the intended Claude Max account, and commit the reviewed Milestone 0 product implementation so it is an immutable worktree base. Beads may subsequently modify only its two explicitly allowed control-plane JSONL exports.
design: This is an operational bootstrap prerequisite, not a product approval or routine integration gate. Yoyodyne must continue refusing to claim agent work when provider authentication is absent or the primary checkout is dirty.
acceptance_criteria: claude auth status --json reports loggedIn=true; the reviewed Milestone 0 implementation is committed; any post-commit primary-checkout changes are limited to .beads/interactions.jsonl and .beads/issues.jsonl; after this prerequisite is closed, go run ./cmd/yoyodyne run --json yoyodyne-ifd.2.1 proceeds past preflight.
close_reason: Claude authenticated and bootstrap base committed

title: Review draft PR #1
description: Run the temporary external PR review protocol for draft PR #1: adversarial subagent review, balanced Copilot review including suppressed findings, inline disposition replies without resolving threads, accepted fixes, and up to four total Copilot rounds.
design: Treat the current requested Copilot review as round one. Give the adversarial reviewer the PR goals and full upstream diff. For every Copilot finding, independently decide correctness, implement correct fixes, reply inline either way, keep threads open, push verified changes, and repeat until clean or four review requests.
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial review is completed and dispositioned; all Copilot findings including suppressed findings are inspected and receive direct inline replies; correct findings are fixed and verified; no thread is resolved; no more than four Copilot requests are made; final PR checks, open-thread state, and review status are reported.

title: Add GitHub Actions CI
description: Add pull-request and main-branch continuous integration modeled on context-anchor, translated to Yoyodyne’s Go build contract.
design: Use a single Ubuntu job triggered by pull requests and pushes targeting main. Grant read-only repository permissions, cancel superseded non-main runs, set up the Go version declared by go.mod with dependency caching, and invoke the Makefile as the canonical local/CI interface.
acceptance_criteria: The workflow runs make check and make build on pull requests and pushes targeting main; action configuration parses cleanly; local make check, make build, git diff --check, and bd lint pass; the draft PR receives the CI check.
notes: Implemented in d13391b. GitHub Actions run 31901806695 passed build in 1m5s on draft PR #1. Local make check, make build, workflow YAML parse, git diff --check, and bd lint passed. The matching context-anchor branch-protection gate cannot be enabled while Yoyodyne remains private on the current GitHub plan; GitHub returned HTTP 403 requiring Pro or a public repository.
close_reason: CI workflow implemented and passing on draft PR #1

title: Wire the automatically integrated happy path
description: Close the first automatic self-hosting happy path by composing developer execution, deterministic checks, independent structured review, harness-owned integration, Beads completion, durable state, and safe cleanup in the single-item run pipeline. A repair verdict or any uncertainty must stop before integration; repair retries remain a subsequent Milestone 1 task.
design: Model post-check review and integration as explicit durable phases with exact developer and reviewer session identifiers, verdict, source commit, integrated commit, and failure details. Run the configured independent reviewer only after checks pass. Integrate only an approve verdict, record and close the Beads item only after the target update succeeds, then clean up the proven integrated worktree. On repair, malformed review, check failure, drift, conflict, interrupted persistence, or cleanup failure, preserve sufficient state and artifacts for diagnosis or reconciliation. Enable automatic integration and a reviewer in the repository config only when the end-to-end policy is enforced.
acceptance_criteria: A fake-backed end-to-end test in a temporary Git repository proves developer change then checks then independent approve verdict then harness commit then fast-forward integration then Beads closure and safe cleanup; tests prove failed checks skip review and integration, repair or invalid review never integrates, reviewer and developer invocations are distinct, target drift is preserved and reported, durable outcomes contain review and integration evidence, and completion ordering survives injected persistence and tracker failures; the real CLI configuration validates with automatic integration; make check, make build, git diff --check, and bd lint pass.

title: Add harness-owned conflict-aware Git integration
description: Add the Git lifecycle primitive that promotes an already checked and approved isolated worktree into its recorded target branch. The harness, never an agent, stages and commits the worktree changes, revalidates the target, fast-forwards only when safe, reports the integrated commit, and cleans up only after integration is proven.
design: Record an immutable target branch and base commit when the worktree is created. Before integration, revalidate owned paths, registration, expected branch, unchanged developer HEAD, nonempty changes, primary-checkout cleanliness policy, and target commit equality with the recorded base. Create a deterministic harness-owned commit, update the target using a fast-forward-only operation, and refuse drift or conflicts without force, reset, or cleanup. Preserve a committed worktree when integration cannot proceed so reconciliation remains possible.
acceptance_criteria: Git integration APIs commit tracked and untracked worktree changes and fast-forward the recorded target only after all safety checks; success returns exact source and target commits and permits safe cleanup; tests with temporary repositories cover success, no changes, developer-created commits, target drift, dirty primary files, invalid ownership or refs, commit failure, non-fast-forward refusal, and preservation on failure; existing worktree tests, make check, and make build pass.

title: Add independent structured review execution
description: Add the first post-check review building block for Milestone 1: collect a bounded review input from the claimed work item, relevant context, actual worktree changes, and configured check results; invoke an independently configured reviewer backend; and decode its final response through the provider-neutral structured verdict contract. Do not yet modify the main run pipeline or integrate changes.
design: Keep review orchestration provider-neutral behind a narrow service. Extend Git inspection with a bounded unified change representation that includes untracked files without mutating the worktree. Invoke the configured reviewer as role reviewer with no write tools and a separate provider invocation/session. Resolve the verdict policy by rejecting approve verdicts that contain blocker or major findings; repair remains authoritative with any valid actionable finding. Preserve provider-specific mechanics inside backend adapters.
acceptance_criteria: A focused reviewer component produces an approve-or-repair Verdict from bounded work-item context, actual tracked and untracked changes, and check results; reviewer execution cannot edit the worktree; malformed, oversized, contradictory, or provider-error output is rejected; tests cover approval, repair, invalid verdicts, diff bounds, untracked files, backend role and permissions, and event sequencing; make check and make build pass.
